title: Understanding Data Types
text: Look at the data types in the table. "Dis" and "Goals" are numerical values, while "League" is a categorical value. Consider how these types relate to the term "qualitative continuous."

hintAnswer: A variable that can take on any value within a range and is categorical in nature.
title: Identifying Qualitative Continuous Variables
text: Which of the following best describes a qualitative continuous variable?
choices: A variable that can take on any value within a range and is categorical in nature.
A variable that can take on any value within a range and is numerical in nature.
A variable that is categorical and has distinct categories.
A variable that is numerical and has distinct categories.
